profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the civil engineering and healthcare industry. Skilled in C#, Javascript, and SQL. Strong engineering professional with a passion for acquiring new experiences in the field.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Industry · Web Engineering · Engineering

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
●Majority of responsibilities included working on CI/CD web applications that works as a streamline web application for the accreditation process for healthcare providers 
●Some sprints would call for me to work on amending bug reports on certain pages of the website, while other sprints would call for me to develop new pages and help coordinate new functionalities that the new web client is featuring.
●Brunt of development work went into porting old features that the old legacy web applications that ACHC used and applying it towards modern projects that utilized more modern javascript frameworks 
●Hands on front-end development experience with VueJS, HTML, CSS, and JS for the modern applications being used in production for applications Horizon and Navigator. 
●Hands on back-end development experience with C#, SQL, ASP.NET and javascript as ways to maintain legacy applications to be in working order as the company moved towards the more modern applications through a Software Development Plan of phasing out the legacy applications in phases
oA significant part of my job working at ACHC went into being the chief expert at managing support engineering tickets for these legacy applications; where tickets are being submitted by Surveyors who facilitate the accreditation process needing support on the field and internal employees who are also in need of development support to complete their work responsibilities on daily basis. 
●Experience with developing, implementing, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in the Azure Public Cloud in the form of supporting those applications stored in the cloud.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Worked extensively as part of an agile development team designing a web application geared towards nurse scheduling in the healthcare field. This would encompass time spent supporting the legacy web application, the building of the reimagined and modern scheduling tool, and the development of supplementary applications to support the former two products.
•Hands on front-end development experience with VueJs, HTML, typescript, and CSS was utilized as the approach for ongoing development to promote the renowned scalability of VueJs for our business and developmental needs
•Hands on back-end development experience with C# and SQL as a way for our team to maintain reusability of legacy code to not impeded on development time to abstract the same functionality to be used in a different language.
•From 2020-2021, I spearheaded full-stack development of the AdminTools application for the ShiftWizard Web Application that provided admin level support functionality to then be reflected on the main shiftwizard application(both legacy and present day). These functionalities include CRUD operations to data fields and also the process of the relocation of page items.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Vue.js · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Worked as part of the many agile scrum teams used to support InterAction, a web application for lawyers to use to manage their clientele functionally similar to how Microsoft Outlook handles its address book of contacts.
•Hands on front-end development experience with Angular, HTML, CSS, and SCSS while using observables as part of the front-end for max optimization of Angular as our chosen framework for web development
•Hands on back-end development experience with C# and GraphQL as a way for our teams to get the full use of the API Gateway Pattern for our back-end needs in our application
•Amongst developers in team, took the initiative to read into unit and integration testing as an expert to better service my team with the usages of Atata Testing to ensure that integration testing from the user’s experience gains coverage; along with karma testing to ensure unit testing coverage was met.
•Assisted in facilitating more BDD approaches with testing by helping teams understand more on how to use Specflow in our existing testing frameworks to get even more coverage out of our tests to ensure high quality of our deliverables

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
•Worked under one of the software development teams in charge of supporting the ecslimited live website, used by technicians and employees for the company.
•Led the UI development for the Signature and Seals tool used for ECSLimited’s IT technicians for uploading signature and seal image files into their system(utilized .NET Framework, backbone marionette, C#, HTML, Javascript, CSS, SQL, Ajax)
•Hands on front-end development experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS and Ajax using backbone marionette as the framework for UI
•Hands on back-end development experience with C# and Entity Framework 6 for the building of Application Programming Interfaces(APIs); along with experience in .NET Framework
•Conducted unit and integration testing via Xunit testing
•Experience using version control systems (i.e. Git and TFS).

positions.title: Assistant Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Assisted in the completion of small projects that the head Software Developer of the College of Nursing’s ITCS department deviated(back-end development mostly utilizing C# and ASP.NET Frameworks)
•Implemented software installation on teachers’ and students’ computers in the College of Nursing
•Worked on database schema designs for college of nursing with the usage of SQL Management Studio
•Understanding of GoLang as a language to convert former C# applications to Golang as a proof of concept

positions.title: Global Understanding IT Assistant
positions.description: ECU IT Assistant for Global Understanding classrooms where I was in charge of establishing and maintaining video/chatrooms connections between classes at ECU with other classes overseas.
